Dogecoin has issued a warning to cryptocurrency owners to beware of any promises or giveaways that claim to multiply their cryptocurrency holdings. “A word of warning: Do not send coins to people claiming they will double, triple, or otherwise multiply your coins. https://t.co/v9bdVoO2Xh

On Friday, Dogecoin rose after Elon Musk claimed he has been working with DogeCoin’s developers to enhance its payment efficiency since 2019. The developers have also stated that a technological improvement is in the works. https://t.co/z7hw0xdBEV

Elon Musk on Thursday said that he has not sold and would not sell any of his dogecoin holdings. Musk responded to a tweet on Thursday suggesting he would never sell any of his doge holdings and that he was the “ultimate hodler” by saying, “Yeah, I haven’t & won’t sell any Doge.” https://t.co/bezgPGk8Wd
